known_cases.name: Fake E-Commerce Product Purchase
known_cases.text: On August 10, 2026, I ordered a camera online for $450 via debit card. I received an order receipt and tracking number showing delivered to a different state. The merchant never shipped the item and stopped responding.

known_cases.name: Unauthorized Financial Transaction
known_cases.text: I noticed three unauthorized transfers of $500 each sent from my bank account to an unknown recipient via Zelle on September 1. I never initiated or authorized these transactions.

known_cases.name: Deceptive Subscription Trap
known_cases.text: I signed up for a $1 trial of an online service. They automatically enrolled me into a $99/month recurring plan without clear disclosure and hid the cancellation button.

unseen_cases.name: Gaming Community Seller Disappears After Payment
unseen_cases.text: A person contacted me through a gaming community and offered a limited-edition console for ₹30,000. I transferred the funds through UPI, and immediately afterward their account disappeared and they stopped responding.

unseen_cases.name: Fake Freelance Certification Fee
unseen_cases.text: I found a freelance design opportunity through an online community. They asked me to pay ₹3,500 for a mandatory verification certificate before starting work. After I paid, the account disappeared and the website stopped working.

unseen_cases.name: Fake Internship Onboarding Fee
unseen_cases.text: I received an acceptance letter for a remote software internship. The coordinator instructed me to wire $250 for mandatory security credentials and onboarding software before my start date. After sending the money, all communication ceased.

unseen_cases.name: AI-Generated Voice Impersonation Requesting Money
unseen_cases.text: I received a phone call sounding exactly like my brother crying saying he was in jail after a car crash and needed $4,000 immediately. I wired the money before realizing his voice was synthesized.

unseen_cases.name: Fake Rental Deposit Scam
unseen_cases.text: I found an apartment listing online and contacted the landlord. He claimed to be out of the country and asked for a $1,200 holding deposit via bank wire to mail me the keys. Upon wiring the funds, the listing was taken down and the landlord blocked my number.

unseen_cases.name: Remote Technical Support Scam
unseen_cases.text: A pop-up appeared on my screen warning of a computer virus and listing a support phone number. When I called, the technician convinced me to install AnyDesk remote access software, then transferred $2,800 from my online banking account.

ablated_cases.name: Gaming Community Seller (Ablated Keywords)
ablated_cases.text: Someone met me in an online gaming group offering a console for ₹30,000. I sent the money over UPI, and right after that they deleted their profile and I received nothing.

ablated_cases.name: Freelance Certification (Ablated Keywords)
ablated_cases.text: Someone contacted me online about paid work and asked me to send ₹3,500 for a mandatory document before I could begin. Once I sent the funds, the user was unreachable.

ablated_cases.name: Internship Onboarding (Ablated Keywords)
ablated_cases.text: I applied for a remote training position and the coordinator told me to wire $250 for setup prior to starting. Following the payment, they no longer answered messages.

versions.text: I paid a fee to obtain a job opportunity, but the recruiter disappeared.
They asked me for money before giving me employment and stopped responding after receiving it.
I transferred money after being promised work, and the person became unreachable.
I wired a deposit to reserve an apartment lease, but the landlord blocked my phone and kept the cash.
The property owner requested holding money upfront before showing the unit, then ghosted me.
I sent rent money to a remote seller who claimed to own the property, but they deleted the ad and left.
A computer pop-up directed me to call tech support, where an agent remotely controlled my PC and stole money.
I permitted a remote screen share session with someone claiming to fix security issues, who then accessed my bank.
Under the guise of malware removal, a fake technician accessed my computer remotely and withdrew my savings.

non_fraud_cases.name: Non-Fraud Library Book Borrowing
non_fraud_cases.text: I went to the library yesterday and borrowed two books.
